title: LLMs instead of Human Judges? A Large Scale Empirical Study across 20 NLP Evaluation Tasks
reasoning: The paper presents a meta-evaluation benchmark (JUDGE-BENCH) to assess LLMs as evaluators across 20 NLP tasks. While it incorporates datasets for 'toxicity' and 'safety' (such as DICES and ToxicChat), these are standard categories in NLP safety alignment rather than a specific focus on religious, theological, or complex moral/ethical systems.
